job_description: The Tecnimede Group has 750 employees around the world looking to the future, united and focused on improving and preserving the health of all of us. Because we own the entire life cycle of medicines for human use, with our own factories located in Portugal and Morocco, and with a Research and Development center in Torres Vedras (Portugal).We are 100% Portuguese, but also international, with a direct presence in more than 100 countries.We are looking for a "Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Manager" to oversee and manage all aspects of health, safety, and environmental protection within our Berrechid facility.Missions:Possess strong knowledge in the pharmaceutical field.Implement environmental and safety policies, procedures, and practices to ensure compliance with regulations.Conduct regular environmental and safety audits to improve and guarantee compliance with standards.Participate in defining quality and sustainable development objectives and monitor progress towards achieving these goals.Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure customer satisfaction and compliance.Work with teams to ensure projects are executed in accordance with established standards.Prepare incident reports, investigate accidents, and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.Candidate Profile:Technical diploma or higher education in environmental engineering.Strong knowledge of environmental and safety regulations, including ISO 14001 and ISO 45001.Proven experience in environmental and safety-related roles.Job Criteria:Activity Sector:Pharmaceutical IndustryCity:BerrechidExperience Level:2 to 5 yearsIn accordance with the provisions of the GDPR and other legislation in force on the protection of personal data, the contracting company guarantees that the processing of your personal data is lawful, fair, transparent and limited to the purposes for which your data was collected.
